title: The way I audibly gasped- like he has never sounded better #WestEnd #...
transcript: I believe our answer matters more than anything they say. I believe there is a way. I believe in us together more than anyone along. I believe that with each other, we are stronger than we know. I believe we're stronger than they know. I believe that we are many. I believe that they are few. But it isn't for you to tell me where to go.
